zh: 其余数据展示与交互卡片全部接上真实的宿主数据源与卡片内交互：时间线绑定 `widget-board:git.log` 读本地仓库的最近提交；列表绑定 `widget-board:sessions.list` 列出活跃会话与工作区；图表与数字绑定 `widget-board:usage.chart` 和 `widget-board:usage.stat`，按会话日志给出最近 7 天每日调用或 Token 趋势以及环比；表盘与进度绑定 `widget-board:capacity.items`，按机器内存、磁盘空间与看板状态额度给出真实占比；表格、键值与 JSON 分别绑定 `widget-board:providers.table`、`widget-board:runtime.kv` 与 `widget-board:board.json`，报告提供方健康记录、运行环境与当前看板快照；链接绑定 `widget-board:repo.links` 识别仓库远端，支持点一行在新标签页打开，也能在卡片里增删自定义书签并存进状态；月历支持点日期格在卡片底部添加或清除持久化日程；Markdown 支持绑定 `widget-board:markdown.doc` 按路径读仓库文档或在设置里填内容；图片支持在设置里切换光晕点阵、几何网格与极光波浪三套封面；同时卡片缩放按屏幕与看板高度动态放开上限（超过 30rem 后按 2rem 一档延伸至最高 240rem），任意列的卡片向右拉宽时自动向左扩展跨满全屏。
en: The remaining data and interactive cards now connect to real host data sources and in-card interactions: Timeline binds `widget-board:git, while card resizing now dynamically adapts to the screen and board height (stepping by 2rem above 30rem up to 240rem) and lets cards in any column expand across the full board width.log` to read recent commits from the local repository; List binds `widget-board:sessions.list` to list active sessions and workspaces; Chart and Stat bind `widget-board:usage.chart` and `widget-board:usage.stat` to report 7-day daily call or token trends and period-over-period deltas from session logs; Gauge and Progress bind `widget-board:capacity.items` for live RAM, disk and board state capacity ratios; Table, Key-value and JSON bind `widget-board:providers.table`, `widget-board:runtime.kv` and `widget-board:board.json` for provider health, runtime info and the active board snapshot; Links binds `widget-board:repo.links` to detect the repository remote, opens links in a new tab on click, and lets users add or remove custom bookmarks persisted in card state; Calendar lets users click a day cell to add or clear persisted events in a bottom bar; Markdown binds `widget-board:markdown.doc` to read a repository file or inline content from settings; Image adds three selectable cover presets (glow, grid and aurora) in settings.
